verdict.rationale: The API reference documents endpoints across the whole product: sending and batch email with idempotency keys, domains, webhooks, suppressions, API keys with scoped permissions, broadcasts, segments and received emails. The llms.txt and docs-md probes and a live OpenAPI spec at /openapi.json (HTTP 200) make the API easy for agents to discover and consume. Hands-on community reports independently praise the SDK breadth, the HTTP logging and the developer experience.
